title: Reset Password wrong location
body:
the reset password file should be in /AAPS/exports/extra and not in /AAPS/extra as it says in https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Maintenance/Update3_0.html
took me sometime to understand why it does not work, hope this will help others.

comments.body: No. path is correct. you probably selected /AAPS/exports as AAPS directory. not /AAPS
